# Official Internet Portal of the President of the Republic of Belarus

> > Official portal of the President of the Republic of Belarus featuring constitutional powers, government structure, state symbols, regional information, and official documents.

This is the official website of the President of the Republic of Belarus, providing comprehensive information about the presidential office, the constitutional framework, state governance, economic sectors, regional profiles, and civil society. The portal serves as the primary source for presidential decrees, directives, and official communications.

## Key Topics

- Republic of Belarus
- President of the Republic of Belarus
- Constitution of the Republic of Belarus
- Presidential powers and status
- Government structure
- State symbols (flag, coat of arms, anthem)
- Minsk (capital city)
- Palace of Independence
- National Olympic Committee
- Religious freedom and organizations
- Social protection
- Electoral system
- Economic sectors
- Regional administration
- Civil society

## Presidential Office and Powers

- [Status and Powers of the President of the Republic of Belarus](https://president.gov.by/en/president/status-i-polnomochiya): Presidential status, powers, election requirements & constitutional authority
- [Статус і паўнамоцтвы Прэзідэнта Рэспублікі Беларусь](https://president.gov.by/be/president/status-i-polnomochiya): Presidential status & powers under Constitution of Republic of Belarus
- [Палац Незалежнасці](https://president.gov.by/be/president/dvorec-nezavisimosti): Palace of Independence in Minsk: presidential residence & state ceremonies
- [Президент Национального Олимпийского комитета](https://president.gov.by/ru/president/nok): Alexander & Viktor Lukashenko as NOK presidents: Olympic leadership role
- [Quotes by Alexander G. Lukashenko](https://president.gov.by/en/president/citaty): Presidential quotes: Lukashenko on sovereignty, security & development

## Official Documents

- [Официальные документы](https://president.gov.by/ru/documents): Presidential decrees, directives, orders & official government documents

## Government and State Structure

- [Государственное устройство Республики Беларусь](https://president.gov.by/ru/gosudarstvo/ustrojstvo): Government structure: unitary democratic state with separation of powers
- [Государственная символика Республики Беларусь](https://president.gov.by/ru/gosudarstvo/simvolika): State symbols: national flag, coat of arms & anthem of Belarus
- [Государственный гимн Республики Беларусь](https://president.gov.by/ru/president/detjam/gimn): National anthem of Belarus: lyrics by Klimkovich & Karizna, music by Sokolovsky
- [Выбары ў Беларусі](https://president.gov.by/be/gosudarstvo/uchastie-grazhdan/vybory): Electoral system: presidential, parliamentary & local council elections

## Economy and Banking

- [Асноўныя галіны эканомікі і флагманы галін](https://president.gov.by/be/belarus/economics/osnovnye-otrasli): Main economic sectors: industry, agriculture, construction, transport & IT
- [Грашовая і банкаўская сістэма Беларусі](https://president.gov.by/be/belarus/economics/denezhnaja-i-bankovskaja-sistema): Monetary & banking system: National Bank, Belarusian ruble & policy

## Regions and Geography

- [Горад Мінск - сталіца Беларусі](https://president.gov.by/be/belarus/regions/minsk): Minsk capital: history, population, economy, culture & tourism highlights
- [Магілёўская вобласць](https://president.gov.by/be/belarus/regions/mogilyovskaya): Mogilev region: history, cities, rivers, population & natural resources

## Society and Social Protection

- [Гражданское общество в Беларуси](https://president.gov.by/ru/belarus/society): Civil society: public organizations, political parties, media & religion
- [Религия в Беларуси](https://president.gov.by/ru/belarus/society/religia): Religious freedom & confessions in Belarus: Christianity, Judaism, Islam
- [Сацыяльная абарона насельніцтва](https://president.gov.by/be/belarus/social/zashhita-naselenija): Social protection system: employment, labor safety, elderly & disability care

## Optional

- [Прысядзібная гаспадарка Прэзідэнта](https://president.gov.by/be/president/bez-galstuka/hozyajstvo): Presidential farm: Lukashenko's agricultural estate & rural traditions
